findings.description: Pair panel opportunities are the union of available query groups; panels unavailable on both sides disappear instead of receiving unavailable status.
findings.requested_change: Derive panel opportunities from complete retained panel inventories and emit explicit unavailable entries.

findings.description: score_rule is reconstructed unconditionally even when command identities differ in actual source or other non-command context. Later pair comparisons use only k0 common_identity, so this can also contaminate source-matched preference comparisons.
findings.requested_change: Require exact common identity across all commands for a native score rule, otherwise retain explicit unmatched status without a preference; gate pair-score comparisons on that status.

findings.description: Final inventory assertions cover positions, original pairs, and groups but omit panel count, unavailable panels, command comparison count and full node-role-command coverage.
findings.requested_change: Check the full fixed inventory and uniqueness, including 804 panels, 12 unavailable panels, 19008 command comparisons and complete both-role/three-command groups.

findings.description: Signed centroid displacement is a vector and therefore excluded from all summary quantiles by the scalar-only type filter. Only its L1 magnitude is summarized.
findings.requested_change: Publish row and column displacement as separate scalar summary metrics or narrow the contract promise explicitly.

positive_assessment: Geometry formulae, raw/normalized separation, units, linear-interpolation quantiles, and exact first-index ties are correct in reviewed code and bounded fixtures. Contract preserves narrator full-distribution access and limits phenomenal/semantic claims.
reviewer: Separate reviewing agent; software/method review only, not an external scientific or semantic audit
